title: Applicability of Article VII, Chapter 6
previewText: The provisions of Section 76-145 (Boundary Line Coinciding With Parks, Cemeteries or Navigable Waters) shall be modified such that where the zoning district boundaries shown on the applicable zoning map coincide with the shoreline, such zoning district boundaries shall be deemed to extend beyond the shoreline to also include any piers contained within the Special Governors Island District.
